The picture quality is outstanding, with deep blacks, rich colors, and incredible clarity that make movies, sports, and streaming feel truly cinematic. The Samsung Vision AI upscaling does a great job enhancing non-4K content, and motion is smooth and responsive, especially for gaming. The Tizen smart platform is fast and easy to use, with quick access to all major streaming apps. The TV also has a sleek, modern design that looks great in any room.
